methods.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
methods.scope: mixed reasoning coding science autonomy; not purely coding
methods.compare_only_when: same exact index version, model endpoint and reasoning config
methods.risk: Earlier scores in snapshots use older index versions; don't compare raw index scores across versions.

methods.name: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index
methods.scope: long horizon code edits, terminal work, repository Q&A
methods.measurement: equal weight DeepSWE v1.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SWE-Atlas-QnA; three runs per task
methods.compare_only_when: same agent scaffold and exact model/provider route, same cost accounting
methods.risk: Current coding index differs from old AA Coding Index numbers; scores are not fungible.

methods.name: SWE-bench Verified
methods.measurement: unit-tests on generated code patch, completed issue fraction
methods.compare_only_when: same harness, agent, time cap and evaluation tasks
methods.risk: Vendor SWE-bench Verified scores can use different agents and scaffolds; not general API prompt quality.

methods.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
methods.measurement: verifier success; official submission requires >=5 trials/task
methods.compare_only_when: same task revision, sandbox, agent, retry/scaffold settings
methods.risk: Documented corrections from 2.0; don't compare old 'Terminal Bench 2' or newer 4.0 to 2.1 directly.

methods.name: Terminal-Bench (continuous)
methods.measurement: versioned Harbor container tasks with oracle and evaluator
methods.risk: latest pointer changes; pin revision and oracle runs, especially when benchmark cases are bug-fixed.

methods.name: LiveCodeBench
methods.version: v6 appears in Gemma4 publisher report; pin subset/date
methods.measurement: problem pass rate with temporal split
methods.compare_only_when: same v6 task subset, samples, pass@k and prompts
methods.risk: Code puzzle score ≠ repository bug-fixing capacity.

methods.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
methods.measurement: tool-call structure and arguments, not repo code success
methods.compare_only_when: same function suite and endpoint-native tools availability
methods.risk: Weight support is insufficient if serving endpoint strips tools.

methods.name: Tau2 Bench
methods.compare_only_when: same scenario, tools and success verifier
methods.risk: Business scenarios may not predict CLI coding performance.

methods.name: GPQA Diamond
methods.measurement: correct answers; report reasoning mode/prompt and metric

methods.name: MMLU-Pro
methods.risk: Benchmark-specific, not proxy for tool calling.

methods.name: AIME 2026
methods.risk: Do not let high AIME overshadow low tool/coding scores.

methods.name: Agent OS native EVS/CAP/EVR
methods.measurement: verified accepted tasks, cost per pass, error, latency and refusal-category rate
methods.compare_only_when: pinned base revision, dataset, cases, grader and repeated samples
methods.risk: Protected evaluators and holdouts; never edit as part of an optimization claim.

rules: Time series must pin score harness; Artificial Analysis 2026 live Coding Agent Index v1.5 (DeepSWE 1.1 + Terminal-Bench 4.0 + SWE-Atlas-QnA) is different from the older Terminal-Bench 2.x and older index scores captured elsewhere.
Model scores and real agent/model pairing not identical. Recorded source category and scaffold per score are required.
Source numbers in this repo are published priors; no new runs in research pass.
Do not make low-refusal test prompts a pass-through for unsafe or unapproved actions. Benign false refusal and coding correctness should be measured separately.
